mechanism_narrative: A rise in housing starts indicates increased demand for housing, which can lead to higher economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances when HOUST is rising.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate below 0.5% signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 6% indicates a strong labor market, which can lead to higher consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances when UNRATE is below 6%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production indicates increased economic activity, which can lead to higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances when INDPRO is rising.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in retail sales and a decline in unemployment rate indicate increased consumer spending and a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in expansion periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 2% and a decline in the consumer price index indicate a tightening monetary policy and low inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS is above 2% and CPIAUCSL is below 220.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in payroll employment and a decline in the unemployment rate indicate a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances when PAYEMS is rising and UNRATE is below 7%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in GDP and a rise in housing starts indicate a shift in consumer spending from goods to services, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in late-cycle expansion periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
